text:
jen: Heads-up: we're seeing recurring p2p stalls on A100 nodes after the NCCL 3.2.1 bump in us-west4. Allgather hangs, kernels waiting on P2P queue. Anyone else?

kevin: saw a few timeouts in the canary logs (canary-154), same cluster. NVLink errors + "socket closed" entries in /var/log/nccl.log. Rolling back probe?

sam-ml: repro on a mixed-arch inference job (A100 + P4) — job hangs after ~1200 tokens. Trace shows repeated "NCCL P2P: UNREACHABLE" and XGMI retransmits. I captured a perf trace and a small core dump.

maria: temporary pod-level workaround: set env NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 — it reduces hangs but perf drops ~25-35% on throughput. Not ideal for critical latencies.

ops-bot: deploybot: canary roll #112 completed — 12/20 failed to reach healthy state (timeout). See https://ci.internal/redwood/canaries/112 for logs.

jen: curious if kernel differences matter here (6.1.x vs 5.15). We saw a similar pattern last year when peer-mem/kernel net stack changed. Need to map driver/kernel combos.

kevin: current fleet config that hit the issue: CUDA 12.1, NVIDIA driver 535.86, NCCL 3.2.1, kernel 6.1.42. Quick guess: 535 <-> 6.1 handshake regression with NVLink/XGMI. Opening vendor ticket (TKT-2334).

sam-ml: quick mitigation proposal: route multi-GPU inference to a pool with NCCL_P2P_DISABLE and reduced model parallelism. Will cost CPU/gpu overhead but prevents hangs. Can we provision extra capacity in us-west4?

maria: finance check — provisioning 50 extra A100s reserved would be $30k+/month. Short-term spot/ephemeral burst will be cheaper but less predictable.

jen: ops plan for now: spin up 20 extra A100 nodes in us-west4 (spot-backed) and route the heaviest models there. Also throttle canaries to 10% traffic. Start a staged rollback of NCCL to 3.1.5 on the remainder of the fleet tonight at 01:00 UTC — rollback window ~2h.

kevin: note that rolling back NCCL requires kernel module reload + full node reboot in our setup (driver stack). Estimate ~45m per node for reboot + checks. We'll stagger to avoid mass capacity loss.

sam-ml: also adding alerts: p2p-timeout rate, log pattern "NCCL P2P: UNREACHABLE", and NVLink retransmit count to SLO dashboards. Will kick off eval reruns to measure behaviour with NCCL_P2P_DISABLE and with 3.1.5.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0318 — assigned: jen, kevin. Incident board: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0318

jen: thanks all. I'll upload the rollback playbook + canary checklist to the incident doc and post a short runbook in #eng-runtime before 00:00 UTC. Please ack when you see it. :thumbsup:
